import matplotlib.pyplot as plt; plt.xkcd()
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(6,4))
ax.set_xlim(0,10); ax.set_ylim(0,6); ax.set_aspect('equal'); ax.axis('off')
ax.text(5,5.5,'FINGERTIP CARTRIDGE ON HOLDER',ha='center',fontsize=10)
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((2,2),5,2.5,fc='lightgray',ec='black'))
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((2,1),5,1,fc='dimgray',ec='black'))
ax.text(4.5,3.2,'rigid core\n+ skin',ha='center',fontsize=8)
ax.text(4.5,1.5,'fingertip holder',ha='center',fontsize=8,color='white')
for x in [3,6]:
    ax.plot([x,x],[1,2],color='black',lw=3); ax.text(x,0.6,'M3',ha='center',fontsize=8)
ax.annotate('rear 4-wire tail',xy=(7,2.5),xytext=(8.2,3.5),arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->'),fontsize=8)
ax.annotate('grip F',xy=(2,3.5),xytext=(0.5,4.2),arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->'),fontsize=9)
ax.annotate('shear / weight',xy=(4.5,4.5),xytext=(6.5,5),arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->'),fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig('sketch.png',dpi=120)
